pages.text: A banquet needs a table, food and seats.$(br2)Keep the table no more than two blocks wide if you can: that way there is floor on every side of it, and a guest will not end up eating on the tabletop.$(br2)Besides the mod's own plated food, placeable dishes from Farmer's Delight, Kaleidoscope and the like are supported as well.

The tables and chairs here are this mod's own seats; any within 3 blocks of one another count as the same banquet. Spreading them out helps guests move about and take food, but not so far that they stop counting.$(br2)A banquet is best held in an open place, where guests can easily come.
Right-click a table with a letter to hold a banquet. Only one banquet can be under way at a time.
